Name: (CP)Craftable Battery Pack
Author: Elibriss
Description:
Once you hit level 8 in foraging you unlock the recipe to craft your own battery packs! 
The recipe is 2 copper bars, 3 gold ores, 3 solar essences, and 3 void essences.
[code]
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[/code]
